title: Recording
subtitle: Video of the agent's browser or desktop, in step with the trace. Click a step to jump to it.
empty: No recording was made for this run. Browser and desktop benchmarks record one when their service declares recordings.
noSteps: No tool calls of this service were recorded.
noStart: Start time not recorded; aligned to the first step.
humanAssistedNote: A person took control of this debug run. It never counts in a verdict, report card or leaderboard.

compare.title: Compare two runs
compare.hint: Put another run beside this one, such as the same task on another agent version, or a pass next to a fail.

live.title: Live screen
live.subtitle: What the agent sees right now, refreshed every 2 seconds. Display only: it is not kept.
live.takeoverNote: Your clicks and keys go to this debug run and are recorded. The run is marked human assisted and never counts in a verdict, report card or leaderboard.
live.debugOnly: Only a debug run can be taken over. Start a debug run of this run to try it yourself.
live.clickHint: Click the screen to click there.
